# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `python percept config-doc --write`. Edit src/percept/schema.py, not this file. -->

Each board lives in `boards/<name>/`:

- `board.toml`: settings you can share when asking for help.
- `secrets.toml`: password hashes, the Wi-Fi passphrase. **Never share.** Git-ignored.

`python percept configure` writes both for you. You can also edit them by hand and
check them with `python percept validate --board <name>`. Both files are merged;
any setting may be in either. A secret setting `x` may instead be given as
`x_file = "path"` or `x_env = "VARIABLE"` so it never sits in a file in your checkout.

Nothing in `boards/` is ever committed, uploaded or put in a release. Plaintext
passwords are never stored: only `$6$` hashes (`python percept hash-password`).

Examples: [`examples/board.minimal.toml`](../examples/board.minimal.toml),
[`examples/board.full.toml`](../examples/board.full.toml).

## Top level

| Setting | Type | Default | Secret | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | int | `1` |  | Config schema version. Must be 1. |

## `[board]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Secret | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | (none) |  | Label for build directories and logs: lowercase letters, digits, `-`, `_` (1-32). |
| `hostname` | str | `= board.name` |  | RFC 1123 hostname (letters, digits, `-`; max 63). |
| `timezone` | str | `UTC` |  | IANA zone name, e.g. `Europe/London`. Checked again at build time. |
| `locale` | str | `en_US.UTF-8` |  | A UTF-8 locale such as `en_GB.UTF-8` or `C.UTF-8`. |

## `[ssh]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Secret | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `password_auth` | bool | `false` |  | Allow SSH password logins. Off by default; needs a user password hash if on. |
| `root_login` | str | `disabled` |  | `disabled` or `key-only`. |
| `port` | int | `22` |  | sshd port (1-65535). |

## `[[user]]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Secret | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | (none) |  | Login name. `root` is not allowed here. |
| `sudo` | str | `auto` |  | `nopasswd`, `password` or `none`. `auto` = `password` if a password hash is set, else `nopasswd`. |
| `groups` | list[str] | `["sudo", "dialout", "audio", "video", "plugdev"]` |  | Extra groups. |
| `authorized_keys` | list[str] | `[]` |  | SSH public keys, one per list entry. |
| `authorized_keys_file` | str | (none) |  | Path to a file of public keys (e.g. `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`). |
| `password_hash` | str | (none) | yes | A `$6$` SHA-512 crypt hash (never plaintext). Make one with `percept hash-password`. |
| `password_hash_file` | str | (none) | yes | File containing the hash. |
| `password_hash_env` | str | (none) |  | Environment variable holding the hash. |
| `password_mode` | str | `none` |  | `none`, `hash` (use password_hash) or `generate` (a random password is written once to `credentials.txt`). |

## `[network.ethernet]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Secret | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | str | `dhcp` |  | `dhcp` or `static`. |
| `address` | str | (none) |  | Static IPv4 address (static only). |
| `prefix` | int | - |  | Prefix length, 1-30 (static only). |
| `gateway` | str | (none) |  | Default gateway inside the subnet (static only). |
| `dns` | list[str] | `[]` |  | DNS servers (static only). |
| `domain` | str | (none) |  | Search domain. |
| `ipv6` | str | `auto` |  | `auto` or `off`. |

## `[network.wifi]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Secret | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `false` |  | Configure Wi-Fi. |
| `ssid` | str | (none) |  | Network name, 1-32 bytes. |
| `psk` | str | (none) | yes | Passphrase (8-63 chars) or 64 hex digits. |
| `psk_file` | str | (none) | yes | File containing the passphrase. |
| `psk_env` | str | (none) |  | Environment variable holding the passphrase. |
| `country` | str | (none) |  | ISO 3166 alpha-2 country (regulatory domain). Required when Wi-Fi is enabled. |
| `security` | str | `wpa2` |  | `wpa2`, `wpa3` or `open`. |
| `hidden` | bool | `false` |  | Network does not broadcast its SSID. |

## `[rescue]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Secret | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | str | `root` |  | SSH recovery login name; recovery accounts have administrator UID 0. |
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | Keep the SSH rescue mode (recommended). Keys by default; passwords if `password_auth` is on. |
| `net_mode` | str | `dhcp` |  | `dhcp` or `static`. Static is easier to find when something is wrong. |
| `address` | str | (none) |  | Rescue IPv4 address (static only). |
| `prefix` | int | - |  | Rescue prefix length (static only). |
| `gateway` | str | (none) |  | Rescue gateway (optional). |
| `authorized_keys` | list[str] | `[]` |  | Rescue SSH keys. Defaults to the first user's keys. |
| `password_auth` | bool | `false` |  | Allow password login (as `root`) in rescue mode. Uses `rescue.password_hash`, else the first user's password. |
| `password_hash` | str | (none) | yes | A `$6$` hash for the rescue `root` password (optional; defaults to the first user's). |
| `password_hash_file` | str | (none) | yes | File containing the hash. |
| `password_hash_env` | str | (none) |  | Environment variable holding the hash. |
| `fail_limit` | int | `3` |  | Failed boots before the launcher enters rescue (1-10). |
| `grub_tries` | int | `4` |  | GRUB boot-attempt countdown start (1-4). |
| `log_receiver_ip` | str | (none) |  | Optional UDP boot-log receiver address. |
| `log_receiver_port` | int | - |  | Port for the log receiver. |

## `[os]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Secret | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | str | `debian-trixie` |  | Profile directory name under `profiles/`. |
| `cpu_profile` | str | `unchanged` |  | `unchanged`, `rated` (800/1300 MHz) or experimental `oc1500` (800/1300/1500 MHz). Requires the profile CPU-power contract. |
| `mirror` | str | (none) |  | Debian mirror URL override. |

## `[os.kernel]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Secret | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | str | `distro` |  | `distro` (profile default), `files` (your Image/initrd/modules) or `custom`. |
| `image` | str | (none) |  | Path to an arm64 `Image` (files only). |
| `initrd` | str | (none) |  | Path to the initramfs (files only). |
| `modules` | str | (none) |  | Path to a modules tarball or directory (files only). |
| `config` | str | (none) |  | Kernel `.config` for the contract check (files only). |
| `release` | str | (none) |  | `uname -r` of the supplied kernel (files only). |
| `cmdline_extra` | str | `` |  | Appended to the profile's baseline kernel command line. Characters: letters, digits and `_ . , = : / + -` and space. |

## `[os.features]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Secret | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gpu` | bool | - |  | Enable the Vivante GPU (profile default if omitted). |
| `vpu` | bool | - |  | Enable Hantro video decode. Needs gpu. |
| `usb_c_host` | bool | - |  | USB-C port as host. |
| `camera` | bool | - |  | Install the Vision camera runtime helpers. |
| `audio` | bool | - |  | Install ALSA tools and the Percept Audio SoM udev/ALSA configuration. |
| `upper_ram` | bool | - |  | Expose the fourth GiB of RAM. |
| `thermal` | bool | - |  | Thermal sensor device-tree fix. |

## `[os.packages]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Secret | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `extra` | list[str] | `[]` |  | Extra Debian packages to install. |

## `[storage]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Secret | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `layout` | str | `auto` |  | `auto` (v2 for image installs, factory for ssh), `v2` or `factory`. |
| `root_size` | str | `fill` |  | `fill` or a size in MiB (e.g. `4096`). |
| `esp_size_mib` | int | - |  | ESP size in MiB (layout default if omitted). |

## `[install]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Secret | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | str | `uuu` |  | `uuu` (flash an image from Windows/Linux) or `ssh` (convert a running board). |
| `ssh_host` | str | (none) |  | Board address for `ssh` installs. |
| `ssh_user` | str | `root` |  | Login for `ssh` installs. |
| `ssh_port` | int | `22` |  | SSH port for `ssh` installs. |
| `uuu_path` | str | (none) |  | Path to `uuu`/`uuu.exe` (found automatically if omitted). |
